# Paddock MCP tools

The tools `paddockctl mcp` can offer, generated from the admin API contract. A session sees only the tools its role, the MCP policy of its scope and the administrator's write access allow (`docs/operations/mcp.md`). Ask the human before calling a tool marked destructive.

## me

| Tool | Class | Destructive | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `getMe` | read | no | GET /api/v1/me |
| `getMySettings` | read | no | GET /api/v1/me/settings |

## things

| Tool | Class | Destructive | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `approveThing` | write | no | POST /api/v1/things/{id}/approve |
| `createThing` | write | no | Create a thing |
| `deleteThing` | write | yes | DELETE /api/v1/things/{id} |
| `listThings` | read | no | List things |
| `replaceThing` | write | no | PUT /api/v1/things/{id} |
| `suspendThingLogins` | write | yes | POST /api/v1/things/{id}/suspend-logins |

## Step-up operations: hand them to the human

These operations need a step-up, which an MCP session never satisfies. They are never offered as tools; the administrator does them in the portal.

| Operation | Tag | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `lockThing` | things | POST /api/v1/things/{id}/lock |

## Other operations the MCP does not offer

Revoking API tokens, the MCP settings and opt-in, uploads and downloads that are not JSON.

| Operation | Tag | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `exportThing` | things | GET /api/v1/things/{id}/export |
| `getMcpCatalog` | mcp | GET /api/v1/mcp/catalog |
| `updateMe` | me | PATCH /api/v1/me |
| `uploadBlob` | platform | PUT /api/platform/v1/blobs/{id} |
